About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in 2016, Deepa Jewellers Ltd. is engaged in the retail and wholesale trading of gold and diamond jewellery, offering a wide range of traditional and contemporary designs.
[1]
Key Points
A B2B Gold Jewellery Supplier:
[1]
Deepa Jewellers is an organised business-to-business (B2B) designer, processor, and supplier of hallmarked gold jewellery. The company does not operate jewellery retail stores or sell directly to end consumers. Instead, it supplies jewellery to retail chains and standalone jewellery stores, primarily across South India.
